'''Norric's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]], located in the section of the station known as [[The Life]]. It was owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Norric]] and it was smaller than the [[Black Hole (Vergesso Base)|Black Hole]] or the [[Docking Bay (cantina)|Docking Bay]].

It was frequented by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] personnel, [[pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] and other [[soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and crewmen. There were some non-Rebel customers but were generally not trusted by the others.
